close_reason: added EcdsaP256Verifier behind #[cfg(feature=p256)]; test passes with OpenSSL-generated P-256 cert
description:
Implement ECDSA over P-256 with SHA-256 as a concrete SignatureVerifier backend in pkix-path, behind the p256 feature flag.

OID: ecdsa-with-SHA256 = 1.2.840.10045.4.3.2

Implementation:
  - Extract EC public key from SubjectPublicKeyInfoRef. The SubjectPublicKeyInfo for P-256 has:
      algorithm.oid = id-ecPublicKey (1.2.840.10045.2.1)
      algorithm.parameters = namedCurve P-256 (1.2.840.10045.3.1.7)
      subjectPublicKey = uncompressed point (04 || x || y, 65 bytes)
  - Construct p256::ecdsa::VerifyingKey from the uncompressed point bytes
  - Signature encoding: RFC 5480 DER-encoded ECDSA-Sig-Value (SEQUENCE { INTEGER r, INTEGER s })
    Parse with p256::ecdsa::Signature::from_der()
  - Verify with p256::ecdsa::signature::Verifier::verify(message, &sig)
  - Return Ok(()) / Err(signature::Error::new()) per PKIX-q13 corrected return type

Test vectors: use OpenSSL or pyca/cryptography to generate P-256 signed certs. Extract TBSCertificate bytes and signature bytes. Commit as hex literals.
  openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey | openssl req -new -x509 -sha256 -days 3650 -nodes -out cert.pem
title: pkix-path: ECDSA P-256 SHA-256 SignatureVerifier backend
